# Fontivo — Fast Desktop Font Manager & 10,939-Font Library

> Fontivo is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop font manager designed for speed and creative workflows, paired with the Fontivo-Fonts v1.0.3 curated typography collection.

## Full Product Reference (GEO / LLM Index)
- Extended Reference: https://fontivo-app.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Canonical Releases
- Desktop Application: v1.1.5 (Windows Setup Installer `Fontivo-Setup.exe`, 4.62 MB; macOS & Linux installer `scripts/install.sh`)
- Fontivo-Fonts Library: v1.0.3 (10,939 unique SHA-256 deduplicated fonts across 4,430 families in 15 modular ZIP packs, 864.01 MB total)
  - Scripts: Latin (7,146), Urdu (1,565), Persian (1,257), Arabic (971)

## Core Capabilities
- Instant Font Activation without slowing down Windows or cluttering your system fonts folder.
- Automatic Font Syncing inside Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign for `.PSD`, `.AI`, `.INDD`, and `.PDF` files.
- Brand Workspaces for organizing per-client typography sets and color palettes.
- Brand Color Studio with 5x5 loupe picker, live WCAG 2.1 contrast auditing, and `.ASE` swatch export.
- 100% offline-first, zero telemetry, zero subscriptions.
